svg.text: EnergyHub — First-Floor Heat-Pump Management
EH policy + native HA bridge/helpers; this controller was not migrated with smart-plug protection
POLICY AND SCHEDULE
Configured Off / Solar-only / Smart choices
Effective schedule and night-operation settings
Family OFF/manual hold constrains restart
Other-floor HP plugs are not native climate control
SOLAR AND BATTERY EVIDENCE
Solar-conditioned permission uses fresh evidence
HP1-only battery episode and stop/recovery gates
Configurable defaults: stop 40%, recovery 50%
Solar permission is not a zero-grid-import guarantee
QUIET / ECO PROFILE
Configured quiet window, not fixed picture times
Grid-aware profiles: Quiet on grid, Eco off-grid
Do not request conflicting Quiet and Eco together
Family profile overrides have bounded ownership
OPTIONAL NIGHT TEMPERATURE
Smart policy may apply a configured night offset
Save baseline; check mode, units and device bounds
Restore only with owned/observed state checks
Explicit family temperature changes release control
COMMAND AND RESTART PATH
EH retains the HP1 journal and pending intent
HA allowlist executes climate actions and ACKs
Fresh context/observations confirm the result
Restart does not manufacture safe ownership
RECOVERY AND LIMITS
Bound Quiet attempts; notify if unconfirmed
Retain manual hold and failure explanations
No automatic HP power-cycle relay management
Extended cold-weather field observation remains
This is management of the installed supported HP1. Do not present it as universal climate-device support or a Core/Custom split.
